definitions: To ignore or disregard something, especially a sound or noise, by consciously or unconsciously blocking it from one's attention.
To stop paying attention to something that is happening or being said.
examples: She learned to tune it out when her neighbours started their loud music.
He tried to tune it out during the boring lecture.
It's hard to tune it out when everyone is talking at once.
pastTenses: tuned out (past simple), tuned out (present perfect)
